items.snippet:
What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7002:Robot not touching the ground, please move robot to a new position, The robot is floating in the air?
1. If the robot is often stuck on the edge of stairs or furniture and triggers this warning, it is recommended to set a no-go zone in the app.
2. If the robot continues to display errors on flat ground, please try restarting the robo

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a tip 7034: Unable to find the starting point, robot will stop running?
When the robot does not start from the station, it needs to return to the starting point after completing the cleaning, but it may not be able to return to the starting point due to obstacles or doors, so it stops running; In this case, please place the robot on the station to

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports tips 7032:Failed to find station, return to start point?
1. If there is no station on this floor, then this message is normal. Please move the robot back to the station manually.
2. If there is a station on this floor, please check whether the station is powered on normally and the white light is on.
3. If the station is powered on normally, place

To ensure that the cleaning quality is not compromised, the robot automatically switches to a "vacuum-only" mode. What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7040: Unable to leave the station, please check the surrounding environment, The robot cannot leave the base station?
If the robot encounters an obstacle while leaving the station, the machine will not be able to start cleaning. Please check the environment around the base station and clear the obstacles.

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7000:Robot trapped, please clear the obstacles, The robot is trapped?

2. If the robot continues to display errors on flat ground, please try restarting the robot and see if it becomes normal.

2. If the robot continues to display errors on flat ground, please try restarting the robot and see if it becomes normal.
